clips.title: The story
paras: At a small Alliance camp on the Webwinder Path, Gaxim Rustfizzle seeks to win over Stonetalon’s night elves. The ambitious gnome scholar and tinker represents the Enlightened Assembly of Arcanology, Alchemy and Engineering Sciences, and aims to prove that artifice and alchemy can preserve their woodland realm. He also bears a fierce grudge against the Venture Company’s destructive operations.

In Stonetalon’s craggy passes, Gaxim Rustfizzle brings night elves a different way to defend the wilds. He represents the Enlightened Assembly of Arcanology, Alchemy and Engineering Sciences, and believes calculated mechanisms and chemical solutions can defend and restore Kalimdor’s wilderness as well as prayers to Elune. Alongside the sentinel Kaela Shadowspear, he camps on the Webwinder Path and works to convince his tall, reclusive allies that engineering can serve the living forest.

The Venture Company’s clear-cutting and industrial greed scar nearby Windshear Crag, drawing much of Gaxim’s effort. He believes their crude goblin machinery deserves neither respect nor mercy, and coordinates covert operations and volatile chemical sabotage against their logging operations. Crippling the shredders and stealing their schematics are operations he coordinates, meant to show that gnomish intellect can defeat careless corporate plunder.
